references.text: For the poor you always have with you, but me you do not always have.
He who shuts his ear to the cry of the poor will himself call out and not be answered.
Is this not the fast I choose: to loose the bonds of injustice, to undo the heavy burdens, to let the oppressed go free, and to break every yoke?
For the poor you always have with you, but me you do not always have.
For the poor you always have with you, but me you do not always have.
